sources.patent-dev: Sample responses from github.com/patent-dev/uspto-odp (MIT), demo/examples, commit 8b4114dd095fccc126fcf16b4884755f7b14c3b3 (2026-11-08). Used only where no live capture exists (TSDR, pending a TSDR key).

endpoints.description: Trademark case status and bibliographic data as JSON ({ trademarks: [ { status: { markElement (the mark text), status (code), extStatusDesc / tm5StatusDesc (status text), filingDate, usRegistrationNumber, ... }, parties: { ownerGroups (keyed by party type code) }, gsList (goods & services by class), prosecutionHistory (events), publication, divisional, internationalData } ] }). caseId: 'sn' + 8-digit serial ('sn97123456'), 'rn' + registration number ('rn6123456'), 'ref' + Madrid reference number ('refZ1231384'), 'ir' + international registration number; a bare 8-digit number is a serial number.
endpoints.example: const r = await tsdr.status('sn97123456'); const t = r.trademarks[0]; return { mark: t.status.markElement, status: t.status.tm5StatusDesc, detail: t.status.extStatusDesc, filed: t.status.filingDate, classes: t.gsList?.map(g => g.primeClassCode) }

endpoints.description: Status for up to 25 trademark cases of one number type in one call (counts as one request). Returns { size, transactionList: [ { searchId, trademarks: [...] } ] } with the same record shape as tsdr.status.

The trademark case's document list (applications, office actions, responses, registration certificates, specimens) as XML text, one entry per document with its type, mail/received date, document id and page URLs. Parse with string methods / regex in the sandbox and return a summary; PDFs cannot be downloaded from the sandbox. Inspect a slice of the XML first to see the element names.
endpoints.example: const xml = await tsdr.documents('sn97123456'); return xml.slice(0, 3000)

endpoints.description: Metadata for one document in a trademark case (XML text), e.g. page count and media types. documentId comes from tsdr.documents.
endpoints.example: const xml = await tsdr.documents('sn97123456'); const id = (xml.match(/<DocumentIdentifier>([^<]+)</) ?? [])[1]; return id ? await tsdr.documentInfo('sn97123456', id) : xml.slice(0, 2000)

endpoints.description: When a trademark case's prosecution history last changed (caseUpdateInfo). Serial numbers only. Cheap way to check whether a cached status is stale.

fields.description: TSDR needs its own API key (USPTO-API-KEY header; separate from the ODP key; get it at account.uspto.gov/api-manager). Rate limit: about 60 requests per minute per key (document/PDF downloads 4 per minute). This server paces TSDR at one request per second per key; use tsdr.multiStatus to fetch up to 25 cases in one request.

TSDR case ids: 'sn' + 8-digit serial number (application), 'rn' + 7-digit registration number, 'ref' + reference number, 'ir' + international registration number. Serial numbers are not patent application numbers.
